producer_boundary.pcgex_role: spatial feature extraction, filtering, sampling and attribute propagation
producer_boundary.yacs_role: BOB owns safe strategy policy, verified-case memory, learning gate and final decision

left_cross_slope.spatial_source: native DTM samples at signed left offsets

right_cross_slope.spatial_source: native DTM samples at signed right offsets

road_to_dtm_delta_m.spatial_source: native DTM sample relative to presentation road elevation

nearest_branch_xy_m.spatial_source: spatial query against non-adjacent road branches

nearest_branch_z_separation_m.spatial_source: height difference for the selected competing branch

pcgex_capability_mapping.filters_and_attributes: classify and propagate feature values without owning terrain policy
pcgex_capability_mapping.sampling: sample spatial datasets and transfer bounded values
pcgex_capability_mapping.heuristics: optional reusable scoring input; final strategy policy remains YACS-owned
pcgex_capability_mapping.tensors: optional spatial influence fields where a later proof demonstrates value

output_rule: PCGEx may emit a feature packet, but BOB owns the terrain decision and must not surrender route/physics authority or verified-case admission.
learning_rule: Only exact-SHA technical PASS plus human visual PASS cases may enter the reviewed YACS case ledger.
